name: norvidrate
title: norvidrate
blurb: a currency converter between USD, EUR, and norvids — 1 norvid is pegged to the dollar cost of running xbill against @norvid-studies.bsky.social's own repo (X's read-API rate card, $5/1000 posts), recomputed once a day. shimmermathlabs.com asked for it, then asked to trim it down to just those three units: "it's too much otherwise."
